# Rejected painted hand transitions

The `before/` pictures preserve the actual selected source drawings from
`4719ce33` before the motion-continuity correction: Lucan 35→36 and Iselin 02→03.
The manifest records profile order, original paths, complete original PNG hashes
and the measured whole-image registration. They are immutable negative fixtures,
not new production animation sources.

The scoped hand detector rejects their independently reviewed 72/79 artwork-pixel
component jumps at the fixed 60-pixel gross-step bound. The separate 40-pixel
diagnostic requests inspection; it is not a universal joint-speed limit. A future
component-selection error requires detector review, not distorted anatomy.
